articles.title: SS7 and Diameter Attacks: How Signaling Flaws Expose Your Phone
articles.summary: Flaws in SS7 and Diameter signaling protocols can allow attackers to track phone locations, intercept calls and SMS verification codes, and impersonate subscribers without compromising their devices. articles.title: GHSA: MultiFactor Authentication for SilverStripe can bypass MFA during password reset flow
articles.summary:
### Impact
In CMS 5, the password reset flow let a user with multi-factor authentication enabled change their password and get a logged-in session before completing multi-factor authentication. Exploiting this requires access to the user's email account. CMS 6 is not affected.
